summary: End-to-end testing of Noir & Or fine-dining MVP. All 6 backend pytest tests pass (root, menu structure, reservation create+list, reservation validation, newsletter idempotent upsert, chef AI multi-turn chat with history). All frontend flows verified on desktop and mobile via Playwright: home page loads with hero 'quiet revelation' text, gold particle canvas renders, reservation modal opens from header and submits successfully showing success screen, all four course tabs (prelude/earth/fire/finale) switch correctly, AI chef chat returns in-character reply, newsletter shows success toast, mobile menu opens with nav links and reserve button.

minor.issue: No server-side validation that the booking date is in the future; past dates are accepted.
Email field uses plain str (not EmailStr) so invalid email formats are accepted.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add server-side check rejecting reservation date < today.
(Optional, low priority) Switch NewsletterSignup.email to Pydantic EmailStr for format validation.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend chef_chat redundantly rehydrates history into the prompt while also passing session_id to LlmChat — works correctly but doubles context cost; one mechanism is sufficient.

ReservationModal closes whenever the user clicks the dark backdrop (onClick={reset}) — also resets all form fields without confirmation, which can frustrate guests who accidentally click outside while filling the form.
MenuSection silently swallows fetch errors with .catch(() => {}); should surface a fallback UI/toast if /api/menu fails.
No loading state on MenuSection while items are empty — section briefly renders without any dishes on first paint.
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix (reservations, newsletter emails) in MongoDB; not cleaned up but isolated by prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_noir_or_api.py and exercise all 6 endpoints including the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY-backed /api/chef/chat multi-turn flow (takes ~6-10s). Frontend reservation modal closes on backdrop click and resets the form — keep that in mind when writing Playwright tests (don't click outside the modal). MenuSection uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' with a 0.6s exit duration — wait at least 1.2s after clicking a course-tab-* before asserting new menu-item-0 content, otherwise the previous course is still rendered.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs blocking the listed acceptance criteria. Initial Playwright run reported 'fire' tab showing 'Truffled Risotto Nero' (an earth dish); RCA: AnimatePresence mode='wait' keeps the outgoing course mounted for the 0.6s exit transition, so a 600ms post-click wait read stale DOM. Mitigation: assertions now wait 1.5s; with that wait all four tabs render the correct dishes.
